title: Ee Bandhana
desc: An old couple sacrifices everything, so their children live a happy life. However, they are forced to separate and subjected to ill-treatment and disrespect in their children's homes.

title: Ganesha
desc: Ganesha makes two promises to his dying father, but trouble ensues in his house when he breaks the first one. Soon, he has to break his second promise in order to avoid more problems.

title: Ayya
desc: An upright police officer is up against a conniving group of criminals. To put them behind bars, he devises a series of unconventional methods.

title: Dashavatar
desc: Two children narrate the story of Lord Vishnu and his ten incarnations who have constantly fought and emerged victorious over any evil that may exist.

title: Thangigagi
desc: Veerabhadra, who loves his sister very much, gets her married to a nice man. However, when Veerabhadra's close friend is killed, he decides to wipe out anti-social elements in the city.
